answer: Each admission burns the operator's comet; the trellis mints exactly one successor and locks a bond equal to the square of the new live count for that identity's life. A successor must present the echo of the burned comet, which the trellis checks against its last head, so a one-identity parent cannot fan out children: the first child burns the head and every stale fork is rejected. A tenth identity locks 100 credits, a first locks one, and a defecting identity forfeits its bond.
